title: Add exponential backoff, retry limits and idempotency keys to PayFlow client
body:
Fixes the Project Alpha payment integration failures from the peak-traffic rehearsal (see engineering meeting #018).

Root cause: the PayFlow API exceeded its timeout under high traffic and our client had no timeout, no retry and no idempotency key.

Changes:
- 800 ms client timeout on every PayFlow request
- Retry transient errors (timeouts, 503, 429) up to 3 times with exponential backoff and jitter; never retry 4xx
- Honor Retry-After on 429
- Idempotency-Key per order, reused across retries, so a retry cannot double-charge

Implemented with Claude Code (session #024); integration tests written with Codex (execution #042).

reviews.body: Looks good. Agreed that idempotency keys are mandatory for every charge going forward; the commit-then-hang test is exactly the case we were worried about.
Approved. This should become the standard for every external API call.

comments.body: Thanks Ben. I will mirror these rules in the api-integration skill so the agents follow them too.
